fields.name: Read scale-out
fields.definition: A deployment in which a write-capable primary handles writes while replica endpoints serve read-only traffic. Examples of such replicas are readable secondaries, hot standbys, read replicas and reader endpoints. ArgentSea supports it through the read/write connection pair. Replication latency, where a just-written record is not yet visible on the read endpoint, is the application's concern; ArgentSea does not retry on the write connection automatically.
